title: Golden Hour Maker's Spark

diffuser.notes: Run 20–30 min while sketching or drafting ideas.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each mist; spray away from face.

why_it_works: Bright tangerine lifts the mood while soft clary sage and grounded cedarwood settle the mind, inviting playful, steady creative focus.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
